name: Blelloch’s Prefix Sum Algorithm
aliases: Parallel Prefix Sum via Binary Tree
definition: An in-place parallel prefix sum algorithm that computes the exclusive prefix sum of an input array using two phases: an up-sweep (reduce) phase to compute partial sums and a down-sweep (scan) phase to compute the final prefix sums.
summary: Blelloch’s Prefix Sum Algorithm is a work-efficient, parallel, in-place method for computing exclusive prefix sums using up-sweep and down-sweep phases.
